purpose: Nonproduction tile-80 style test for bead pulp_wars-305: city, Fighter, Marksman and grass in Flat-shaded (Pixflux) and Bold chibi (Pixen) at an 80 CSS px base tile, generated natively at DPR 1. Not read by art:validate, the asset registry or the runtime.
camera: Consistent strategy-game camera: three-quarter view looking slightly down, subject faces down-right (south-east), whole subject visible and centered on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.
ownerColor: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance; no other red anywhere.

subjects.fighter: Subject: one chunky cute fighter unit (a basic sword warrior) for a playful turn-based strategy game, big head and short sturdy body, simple rounded steel helmet with a red crest, oversized short sword held up in the right hand, round wooden shield on the left arm, bright red tunic covering the torso, brown boots, both feet visible, standing ready pose, strong readable silhouette. The boots are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.marksman: Subject: one chunky cute marksman unit (a basic archer) for a playful turn-based strategy game, big head and short sturdy body, bright red pointed hood, big tall wooden longbow held upright in the left hand with the string visible, quiver of arrows on the back, bright red tunic covering the torso, brown boots, both feet visible, no shield, no sword, no helmet, standing ready pose, strong readable silhouette clearly different from a sword fighter. The boots are the lowest thing in the image.

city.prompt: Subject: one small fantasy town as a single strategy-game map piece: a compact cluster of four chunky cottages with bright red roofs huddled around one tall round stone keep tower with a big red banner flag on top, short stone ring wall in front, compact footprint, strong readable silhouette. The walls and houses stand directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under them; the bottom of the stone wall is the lowest thing in the image. The town fills most of the image.

grass.prompt: Subject: one seamless tileable square grass terrain texture for a strategy-game map: an even bright fresh green meadow filling the entire image edge to edge, a few small grass tufts scattered evenly, no single focal object. The left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge continues into the bottom edge, so copies placed side by side join without any visible seam.
grass.camera: Straight top-down view of flat ground, the texture fills the whole square canvas, no perspective, no horizon.
grass.negativePrompt: border, frame, outline around the square, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, path, road, water, rocks, flowers, trees, buildings, characters, text, perspective, horizon, red

lawn.prompt: Subject: a close-up patch of short flat lawn grass seen from directly above, one even bright fresh green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely everywhere. The lawn is cropped out of a much larger field: it continues past all four edges of the image, so there is no border, no frame, no edge decoration and no object in the middle.
lawn.camera: Straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient.
lawn.negativePrompt: border, frame, hedge, bushes, outline around the image, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, path, road, water, rocks, stones, flowers, trees, buildings, characters, text, perspective, horizon, red, tile edge, square island

field.prompt: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short lawn grass seen from directly above, one even fresh green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, the same everywhere, nothing else.
field.camera: Straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient.
field.negativePrompt: border, frame, hedge, bushes, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, path, road, water, rocks, stones, flowers, trees, buildings, characters, people, text, perspective, horizon, red

city-cutout.prompt: Subject: a small cluster of chunky medieval buildings for a strategy game: one tall round grey stone tower with a big red banner flag on top, and three small cottages with bright red roofs pressed tightly around the foot of the tower, one short stretch of stone wall in front. The buildings stand directly on the empty transparent background: the bottom edges of their own walls are the lowest pixels, with nothing under them. Big and filling most of the image.
